obligations.requirement: All ten closed G3 WP decisions and exact result revisions are present and valid.
obligations.oracle: Independent report generator validates the WP decision matrix, result identities, and package/evidence references.
obligations.acceptance: No missing, duplicate, stale, or non-PASS WP decision is accepted.

obligations.requirement: Runtime and render evidence for the completed G3 vertical slice is present and successful.
obligations.oracle: Generator validates required runtime, render, and host evidence records against exact main revision.
obligations.acceptance: All required evidence categories are PASS and commit-bound.

obligations.requirement: Locality/performance evidence and stale-generation negative coverage are explicit.
obligations.oracle: Generator checks locality counters and stale-generation rejection observations from closed WPs.
obligations.acceptance: Both obligations are independently represented and PASS.

obligations.requirement: Required platform evidence is classified as PASS, BLOCKED, or NOT_APPLICABLE without synthetic success.
obligations.oracle: Generator rejects absent/invalid platform evidence and emits BLOCKED when a required platform is unavailable.
obligations.acceptance: Platform status is explicit and promotion is allowed only when every required profile is PASS.

obligations.requirement: The G3 Gate Report is generated by tooling and is not a copied G0 report or producer claim.
obligations.oracle: CLI generates the report from bound inputs and schema-validates it.
obligations.acceptance: Generated report identity and input hashes are recorded.
